title: Rust secure_rpl_public fixtures use link-local address as native RPL origin
description: lichen-node/tests/secure_rpl_public.rs constructs RplStack::provision_leaf with SecureStack::local_addr(), which is the fe80:: control address. Production validate_origin correctly requires ygg_addr_from_pubkey as the native RPL/DAO origin, so both public integration tests fail InvalidOrigin. Update fixtures to derive the canonical native address from the identity public key while retaining link-local for control traffic, then run the full lichen-node suite.
notes: Fixed public Secure RPL tests to use key-derived native address for RPL origin/DODAG and retain fe80 control destination. Focused and full lichen-node suites pass.
